svg.title: A three-tier web application behind Amazon CloudFront
svg.desc: Users send requests to Amazon CloudFront. Amazon CloudFront forwards each request to an Application Load Balancer in the public subnets of a VPC. The load balancer forwards the request to one of two EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group in private subnets. The instances use a primary DB instance in other private subnets. The primary DB instance replicates to a standby DB instance in a Multi-AZ deployment.
